reviews.t: I have tried more than 15 different bars and have not been disappointed yet. I like the fact that I am ...
reviews.x: I am so addicted to Zum bars! The scent of these soaps are out of this world! I have tried more than 15 different bars and have not been disappointed yet. I like the fact that I am using a natural product, and my skin feels and smells so good! I have purchased several gift boxed for friends and family, I always get a great thank you and the same question where did you get this? Now, this is a natural product so it will go much faster than other bars of soap. I keep my soap in a covered container
(sniff, sniff...) Mmmmm! These smell so good! The little things in the soap are a nice exfoliator. Leaves skin smelling and feeling clean. Will definitely be buying more.

I really love all the Zum products but this bar soap has little lingering fragrance.  There is only a faint hint of patchouli.  I wish I had only tried one bar instead of buying four but I was counting on this one being like all the rest that I have tried.  I would return if I could.  I will switch back to frankincense and myrrh as this one definitely needs reformulation.
I have been a fan of Zum Soaps for years, and a fan of patchouli even longer! So Patchouli mixed with Zum is a winning combo!

reviews.t: Not only do I love these as soap
reviews.x: Not only do I love these as soap... but leaving your extra bars out in any room will actually work as an air freshener.
If you are looking for great aroma therapy in the bath or shower these are something to try. I love all four aromas.
hippie dippie land, great for the waaay back machine

reviews.t: Good soap and very fragrant......but pricey...
reviews.x: This is great soap.....especially if you like the essential oil scents that they come with.  But the bars are a bit soft so they are used up fairly quickly and because of their expense I can't say that they are a bargain in this regard.  Also, I have had some deliveries with evidence of poor packaging for shipment.  The box contents were not adequately prevented from being bounced around inside the box during shipment which made for disheveled contents and some chipped bars of soap.  Not a big d

I have recently decided to try to eliminate the use of some of the products I use daily that contain harsh chemicals, and I started with switching to goats milk soap. I found Zum products while browsing Amazon, and the ingredients as well as the scents lead to my decision to try this. I love it! It smells amazing, it lathers well, and it leaves my face and body feeling extra clean. I will be purchasing again, and I think I will try the lavender bars next.

The soaps smell great, but the bars did not last long at all. The scent was not very noticeable after using them in the shower, and they dried out my skin most of the time. I don't think this product was worth the price, as the soaps were smaller than I expected and pretty expensive.

reviews.t: Strong smell for my sensitive nose
reviews.x: Very strong smell.  I wrapped these in a Christmas box a month before Christmas.  The smell was so strong that I had to move the box into a hall closet.  I was unsure about having them in the car on the 2 hour drive to my sister's house.  My sister loved them, though.

reviews.t: My skin actually feels great without lotion!
reviews.x: Wow there's something about this soap. I've used it once and the dry patches on my skin are disappearing. I thought lotion was the solution but I think it's all the harsh soap I've always used. Really cleans without drying your skin out. Smells divine.

reviews.t: Love the different combinations you get in this set
reviews.x: Love the different combinations you get in this set! Patchoulli is the main scent, BUT the subtle underscents really come through. A definite re-order will be on the horizon...which may be sooner that expected, because I use it just to use it! LOVE!
This is the best soap - it is so clean smelling.  I have been using it for about 5 years and I love it.  Often times people will say - "you smell good" it is the soap.

Love this soap!  I have been suffering from eczema on my hands for over a year.  It would get so bad that I couldn't put my hand in hot water without intense itch.  From scratching, I had a huge raw spot on my palm.  My husband bought me the Patchouli soap because I love the smell of patchouli.  It is scented so well that the soap never looses the smell - and it makes the bathroom smell wonderful.  It leaves just a faint smell on the skin that is barely noticeable. After a week or so of using th

What's not to like about Zum Bars?  I had no idea what these would smell like, but I knew they'd be good.  At first it seemed like the bars weren't lasting that long, but when I was done with these I used a bar of Caress soap and they seemed to last about the same amount of time.  I don't buy these regularly because they're kind of expensive, but they're nice every now and then and they make great gifts.

Absolutely love the zum bars-while my favorite is the sea salt, the patchouli-frankinsence is quickly growing on me.  Haven't tried any of the others from this pack yet, but I'm sure I'll be pleased.  One note is that with the patchouli scented ones, sometimes I have itchy skin after use...never have the problem with the sea salt, but maybe I just have sensitive man skin...ha

reviews.t: They use castor oil in this soap.
reviews.x: I wish I would have researched the horrible side effects from castor oil being put on the skin.  I broke out in a really bad, itchy, stinging, burning red painful rash that did not go away for days.  In addition it caused itching in my private areas that was like a living hell.  I would never purchase this soap again!

Given to my mother for Mother's Day...she said,"They're outstanding.  I love how I smell after a shower."  High praise from a woman who loves to smell like the hippie she was in the 70s...only with more deodorant!

This is a pretty, great-smelling soap that has turned me back into a "bar user." Each one smells distinctive and lathers well, and I love the shape.  Definitely one of the best things I've bought this year.
I absolutely love this soap! My entire bathroom now pleasantly smells of patchouli------the bar is lasting, and it is not "turning soft" as many bars do on my ridged soap dish. Great product!

reviews.t: Purchased as gift and arrived broken in pieces. Got ...
reviews.x: Purchased as gift and arrived broken in pieces. Got replacement and bar for myself. Smell isn't there and does not lather well. Not a fan of goat's milk I guess.
This is a nice assortment of Patchouli blend soaps. I really like Zum products!

We have been using Zum soap for a couple years now and we love it. My husband and I use patchouli and our teenager uses tea tree citrus. People recognize our scents and compliment us all the time (which is kind of weird and awkward sometimes and yet still pretty awesome). This is a "soft" soap so a bar will not last as long as a bar of Irish Spring soap, but it made with a different process and with different ingredients. We all love our zum.

I bought one of these bars just to try it out. Within 5 minutes, I was completely hooked! The soap makes a rich creamy lather that softens the skin and leaves a light fragrance. It also rinses away nicely with no residue. I'm getting down to the last several washes with the bar I have, and just purchased this Patchouli 4 Ways Pack. I can't wait to get them. Totally love this product. Hugs and Kisses to the Goats who helped make the soap xoxox

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the soap's scent, describing it as strong, pleasant, and long-lasting.
Several customers report that the soap leaves their skin feeling clean, soft, and moisturized, with some citing relief from dry patches or eczema.
Some reviewers find the bars soft and fast to use up, and consider the product expensive or not a good value.
A few customers mention weak or faint fragrance, contrary to the majority who praise the scent.
Some reviewers note the scent can be very strong, which may bother sensitive noses.
